name: framecore-works-toolbox
description: FrameCore Works personal toolbox: reviewed third-party skills and plugins, each pinned to a full upstream commit.

plugins.name: toolbox
plugins.description: Type "toolbox" to list the plugins in this marketplace, where each one works, and how to install and use it.

plugins.name: ponytail
plugins.description: Lazy senior dev mode: YAGNI, stdlib first, smallest correct change. Always-on via SessionStart and SubagentStart hooks; local task ledger.

plugins.name: animate
plugins.description: Short procedural animations in any style (explainers, histories, product reels) as single-file canvas videos rendered to MP4, with story, look and storyboard check-ins.

plugins.name: motion-designer
plugins.description: Launch films of your app (real UI in a phone or laptop frame) and other short videos from code, cut to music and rendered to MP4, loop, poster and HTML.

plugins.name: logo-design
plugins.description: Designs, critiques and delivers logos (brief, concepts, SVG construction, testing, brand guidelines) with a library of 1,400+ reference logos.

plugins.name: antislop
plugins.description: Six rule skills that keep UI, copy and code from looking AI-generated, plus a local colour-contrast checker.

plugins.name: meta-ads-designer
plugins.description: Art-directs and generates Meta/Instagram ads, posters and flyers with an AI image model, then checks the result.

plugins.name: hallmark
plugins.description: Designs web pages and app UIs that do not look AI-generated, with themes, a slop linter and optional generated images (Together AI).

plugins.name: open-design
plugins.description: Connects Claude to the local Open Design app (139 design skills, 150 design systems, projects and previews) over MCP; needs the app installed.
